title: Install Nexis
lede:
One-time setup for your website, admin account and database.
Nexis is a product of :vendor and is licensed under GPL v2 or later.
field.primary_domain_hint: Without protocol – e.g. localhost or example.com. For a real domain the installer sets APP_ENV=production and APP_DEBUG=false.
field.app_url_hint: Base URL including subdirectory, if any
field.default_locale_hint: Both German and English are installed. The default language controls start URLs and fallback.
field.admin_password_hint: Saved as platform admin — choose a strong password.
field.db_database_hint: Letters, numbers and underscore only. Created if needed. The DB user needs CREATE/ALTER/INDEX/SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP.
db_check.ok: Database connection and privileges look good. You can start the installation.
db_check.ok_existing: Connection OK – but the database already contains :tables table(s) (:sites site row(s)). Enable “Wipe database” below for a clean reinstall.
reset.title: Existing database detected
reset.warn: “:database” already has :tables table(s) (:sites sites). Reinstalling without wiping will fail (e.g. duplicate domain).
reset.label: Delete all tables in this database and reinstall
reset.hint: Irreversible – all data in this database will be lost. Other databases are not affected.
plugins_hint: Forms (contact page), redirects and consent banner
error.csrf: Invalid CSRF token. Please try again.
error.required: Please fill in all required fields.
error.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error.db_connection: Could not connect to the database: :message
error.db_create: Could not create the database (missing CREATE privilege?): :message
error.db_not_empty: Database is not empty (:tables tables, :sites sites). Enable “Wipe database” or choose an empty database.
error.rate_limit: Too many installation attempts. Please try again later.
already.title: Already installed
